## English
- Listen to each translation from the speaker button beside Copy. Voices follow the target language and your American or British English choice, including older English translations. - Click the active speaker button to stop reading. Starting another translation ends the previous one. - Inputs containing only a skill name and its path no longer create learning records or invalid translations. Requests that include normal sentences are still collected.
## 中文
- 《亦言》在每种译文的复制按钮旁加入朗读按钮，按目标语言和英美口音朗读，旧版英文译文也可使用。 - 再次点击正在播放的朗读按钮即可停止，切换到其他译文时会自动结束上一段朗读。 - 仅包含技能名称和路径的输入不再采集，避免出现无效译文；包含正常语句的请求仍会保留。

## English
- After updating from YiYan, the application in Applications now adopts the Yilo name automatically. - The Dock and Cmd+Tab show the current application icon after launch. - Your learning records and preferences stay as they are.
## 中文
- 从旧版升级后，应用程序文件夹中的《亦言》会自动更新为 Yilo 名称。 - 修复启动后 Dock 和 Cmd+Tab 仍显示旧图标的问题。 - 保留已有学习记录和设置。

### 更新内容
- 《亦言》现以 Yilo 为英文名称，并换上更清晰明亮的新图标。 - 一次选择多种目标语言，按顺序查看完整译文与学习提示；语言选择和设置更容易理解。 - 日语支持在对应文字上方显示平假名或罗马字，字号更清楚，换行更自然。 - 中文新增拼音与注音，可自行切换；简体默认拼音，繁体默认汉字右侧直排注音。 - 默认目标语言跟随源语言：英文对应简体中文，其他语言对应英文；手动选择后保留自己的配置。 - 可从菜单栏暂停采集；默认跳过简短确认、带明显段落标记或超过 200 字符的内容，长度上限可以调整。 - 改善译文长时间等待的问题，让后来的内容也能继续翻译。 - 修正各语言的界面文案，让设置和学习提示更自然易懂。
### What’s new
- A new English name, Yilo, and a brighter, clearer app icon. - Choose multiple target languages and see complete translations and learning notes in your chosen order, with clearer language settings. - Japanese Hiragana and Romaji align above the matching text, with more readable sizing and natural wrapping. - Chinese now offers Pinyin and Zhuyin. Simplified Chinese defaults to Pinyin; Traditional Chinese defaults to upright Zhuyin beside each character. You can change either choice. - Default targets follow your source language: English translates into Simplified Chinese, and other languages into English. Your manual choices are remembered. - Pause capture from the menu bar. Short acknowledgements, clearly structured passages, and inputs over 200 characters are skipped by default; the length limit is adjustable. - Fixed translations waiting too long and preventing newer entries from being translated. - Improved wording across all supported interface languages.

### 更新内容
- 修复 Codex 定时自动化任务的内容仍被误收进学习记录的问题，重启《绎言》后也会跳过这些内容。 - 同一聊天里手动发送的内容仍正常收录，避免遗漏或重复。
### What’s new
- Fixed Codex scheduled automation instructions still appearing as learning records, including after restarting YiYan. - Manual messages in the same chat continue to be collected without being skipped or duplicated.

### 更新内容
- 修复清空或删除学习记录后，旧记录过一会儿又重新出现的问题。离线清空、重启或在同步过程中清空，也能保留删除结果。
### What’s new
- Fixed deleted or cleared learning records reappearing later. Deletions now stay in effect after clearing offline, restarting the app, or clearing while sync is in progress.
